object.attr: derived: clients keep their logs, and a confidential project's requirement text would end up outside the repository (CF-M62). Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-M10): descriptions and commit messages are logged at `DEBUG` only.
object.description: While the log level isn't `DEBUG`, the MCP server shall write no parameter value of a tool call to standard error other than IDs, attribute names and paths.
